title: 2012 AMC 10B Problem 19
statement: In rectangle \(ABCD,\) \(AB=6,\) \(AD=30,\) and \(G\) is the midpoint of \(\overline{AD}.\) Segment \(AB\) is extended \(2\) units beyond \(B\) to point \(E,\) and \(F\) is the intersection of \(\overline{ED}\) and \(\overline{BC}.\) What is the area of quadrilateral \(BFDG?\)

solutions.text:
The polygon \(BFDG \) is a trapezoid with bases \(DG\) and \(BF\) and height \(6.\) Also, since \(G\) is the midpoint between \(A\) and \(D,\) we have \(GD= 15.\)

We can see that \(EBF \sim EAD ,\) so \[\dfrac{BF}{AD} = \dfrac{EB}{EA} \] \[\dfrac{BF}{30} = \dfrac 28 \]\[BF = 7.5\]

This makes the area of \(BFDG\) equal to \(\dfrac{6(15+7.5)}2 = \dfrac{135}2.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: Quadrilateral \(BFDG\) is a trapezoid with height \(6\)
